JAK-like candidates — 20 proteins

Twenty proteins screened for the JAK phenotype: two or more folded domains, a real inter-domain interface present in the compact state and absent in the extended one, and an AlphaFold arrangement the templates do not agree with. Four references anchor the list — JAK itself plus FAK, SHP2 and the Jeanpierre JAK1 models — and must rank at the top for the criterion to be trusted. Every number is computed from the structures linked below, not quoted.

22 proteins 99 structures measured 22 PAE maps AlphaFold DB v6 Generated 28 Oct 2026

Summary

Ranked by the interface criterion from more_proteins/jak_analogue_search_proposal.md: a candidate must have a real inter-domain interface in its most compact structure that is lost in the extended one. Contacts are distinct residue pairs with heavy atoms within 5 Å, max and min across all structures measured. PAE ratio is mean inter-module predicted aligned error divided by mean intra-module — above ~2 means AlphaFold is confident about each domain and unsure where they sit relative to each other. What the 3D views show. Cα traces only, so the backbone path is real but side chains are absent. pLDDT colouring applies to the AlphaFold model (blue = confident, orange = not); template files carry whatever their source put in the B-factor column, which for SWISS-MODEL is a per-residue quality estimate and not pLDDT — so read pLDDT colouring on the AlphaFold model only. Domain colouring uses the UniProt Domain ranges, which omit some subdomain architectures (notably receptor tyrosine kinase ectodomains).

What the tables show. One row per structure: the centroid distance between the two domains of the pair, the number of inter-domain residue contacts, and what fraction of each domain is actually present. A structure with low coverage gives an unreliable centroid.

Structures: AlphaFold DB v6 (alphafold.ebi.ac.uk), SWISS-MODEL Repository, RCSB PDB, ModelArchive. Domain boundaries: UniProt. PAE matrices downsampled by block-mean for display; inter/intra ratios computed on the full matrices. Geometry computed with more_proteins/interface.py and superpose.py. Rendering: 3Dmol.js 2.4.2.
